entries.title: 📦 The promised package
entries.text:
[i]“The boss mentioned you would be sending something over. He mentions it every Tuesday.”[/i]

The marquee package you promised {studio} is now a standing item in their story meeting — and in yours. Time to assemble something with names on it.

quest.title: A package for the studio boss

choices.label: Get to work — the boss is watching

effects.text: The package for {studio} takes shape on your desk.

choices.outcome: Scripts, names, numbers — the folder grows. Eight weeks to make it sing.

choices.label: Let it slide — other fires are burning

effects.text: The promised package for {studio} gathers dust. The boss notices. Bosses always notice.

choices.outcome: The folder stays thin. On the lot, a notebook opens — and closes.

entries.title: 📦 Delivery day at {studio}
entries.text: The story meeting falls silent as your folder makes the rounds. This is the moment the summit was really about: not the apology — the follow-through.

choices.label: Present the package like a premiere

effects.text: The package lands at {studio}. The boss's Tuesday remark is retired.

choices.outcome: Nods around the table, and from the head of it the rarest sentence on this lot: “Good work.”

effects_fail.text: The package for {studio} lands — flat. Better than nothing, worse than promised.

choices.outcome_fail: The folder is solid; the pitch is not. They keep two names and forget the rest — including, for a while, yours.

choices.label: Admit the package never came together

effects.text: You walk into {studio} empty-handed. The word for that on this lot is unprintable.

choices.outcome: Honesty is worth something in this town. Not much, on delivery day, but something.
